verdict.rationale: Meilisearch has a dedicated hybrid search capability. The docs state it combines full-text keyword matching with semantic meaning matching, auto-generates embeddings once an embedder is configured, and serves both through a single API. The product page also promises keyword precision combined with AI understanding of intent. missing for 10: explicit documentation that both are fused within one query request, details on fusion or weighting controls (e.g., a semantic ratio), independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid search.
